RISC OS sources in Eclipse

This is an Eclipse update site, for Eclipse to read rather than a page to browse.

To install the plugin, in Eclipse choose Help › Install New Software…, click Add…, and give this page's address as the Location:

https://bavison.github.io/riscos-eclipse/

Then tick the features under RISC OS and follow the user guide. Eclipse checks this site for new versions with Help › Check for Updates.

To install without this address, download riscos-eclipse.zip and choose it with Archive… instead.
